definitions.explanation: A lord to whom a vassal or retainer owes loyalty and service. Primarily a historical term from feudal Japan, frequently encountered in period dramas, historical fiction, and discussions of samurai culture.

examples.japanese: {主君|しゅくん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忠誠|ちゅうせい}→忠誠：12593_chuusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誓|ちか}った→誓う：00030_chikau⟧。
examples.english: He swore loyalty to his lord.

examples.japanese: ⟦{侍|さむらい}→侍：10499_samurai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{主君|しゅくん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{懸|か}けて⟦{戦|たたか}った→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
examples.english: The samurai fought at the risk of their lives for their lord.

examples.japanese: {主君|しゅくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}った→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧⟦{家臣|かしん}→家臣：12655_kashin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{罰|ばっ}せられた→罰する：02401_bassuru⟧。
examples.english: Retainers who betrayed their lord were severely punished.

notes:
A historical term central to discussions of Japanese feudal society and samurai culture. Commonly encountered in ⟦{時代劇|じだいげき}→時代劇：12968_jidaigeki⟧ (period dramas) and ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (historical novels).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主君|しゅくん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕|つか}える→仕える：11547_tsukaeru⟧ (to serve one's lord)
- {主君|しゅくん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忠誠|ちゅうせい}→忠誠：12593_chuusei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誓|ちか}う→誓う：00030_chikau⟧ (to pledge loyalty to one's lord)
- {主君|しゅくん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to protect one's lord)
- {主君|しゅくん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{命|めい} (the lord's orders)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{家臣|かしん}→家臣：12655_kashin⟧: retainer, vassal (the one who serves)
- ⟦{殿様|とのさま}→殿様：10455_tonosama⟧: lord (more colloquial/honorific)
- ⟦{大名|だいみょう}→大名：10378_daimyou⟧: feudal lord, daimyo (specifically a domain ruler)
- ⟦{将軍|しょうぐん}→将軍：12386_shougun⟧: shogun, military commander
